title: Hinomori Shiho — Filled With My "Thanks"〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!

rows.Line: White Day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But this really isn't all that different from giving chocolates to Ichika and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seem like you're in a good mood, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Can you tell?
I got a return gift from Haruka just a bit earlier!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She made these chocolates herself too!
I'm gonna cherish them forever...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, you should eat them.
I mean, that's why she made them for you, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right! She even said so herself.
As much as I don't want to, I'll make sure to eat these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, that reminds me. You went to the Chocolate Factory with Haruka, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
I couldn't believe it when Haruka told me about what happened...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We just happened to realize that we were both looking up what the Chocolate Factory's like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It also seemed like the perfect opportunity for me to make some chocolates in secret for Saki and the others, so I decided to invited her along.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, this is my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So what was the Chocolate Factory like, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka already told me what she thought, but I'd really love to hear from you too, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What I thought...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it was a factory as advertised, but the tour was mostly centered around its museum.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Although, I don't think any of us were expecting to be surprised with a show right off the bat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka told me about that too!
Like how these chocolate fairies guided you around and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, Chocomi and Chocoko.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, their names even make it sound like they're chocolate fairies!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, very true...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But they weren't your usual fairies with wings or anything. They looked just like bars of chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-Bars of chocolate?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. The kids loved them, but it was pretty surreal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm having trouble imagining what they're like now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm not really sure how else to describe them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, it might be good to go see them for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Definitely! It'd be great to go when Tsukasa's there performing as an extra too♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you heard about that too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something happened to the cast member who was performing alongside him, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And everyone worked together to keep the show going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But I doubt you'll ever get to see a repeat of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, now's my chance...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, you two...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here... I made these at the Chocolate Factory. Thank you both for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, for us?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shiho!
I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I can't just take and not give back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still, I never saw myself giving chocolates to anyone other than Saki or the girls.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Please open them when you get home.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! It's a chocolate bunny! It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You opened it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? H-Hahaha...
Sorry, I couldn't resist...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
U-Um... Shiho?
Can I open mine too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By my guest...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, I got a lop rabbit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're bunny's really cute too!
I really like how it's smiling!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're both welcome...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I should be the one thanking you two...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (For celebrating my birthday, exchanging gifts on Valentine's Day and just being there to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I sort of can't believe how well I'm getting along with my classmates.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's kinda nice to make something myself for a change.)
